title: Bucket hat with 4 and smile
slide_intent: Test how a symbol and a small playful detail communicate at wearable scale.
strategic_value: A green signature beside a smile can make Channel 4 merchandise recognizable without a large slogan.
demonstration: A rear view of a black bucket hat shows a small green 4 and an outlined smiling face.
practical_value: Compare the scale and spacing of a brand mark with a companion icon on fabric.

content_islands.name: Hat graphics
content_islands.spec: Place the small green 4 and smile apart on the black hat.

content_islands.name: Wearer
content_islands.spec: Keep the person and pale background to show how the embroidery reads when worn.

reference_purposes.Application: The 4 and smile icon appear on a worn bucket hat.
reference_purposes.Expression: Small green graphics contrast with the black fabric.
